propositions: Command syntax is currently split across reusable argparse parsers, imperative argv loops, 54 hand-maintained help files, and 22 curated descriptions, allowing parser, runtime help, and documentation to disagree

A single argparse factory per command grammar must be established as the canonical source, with generated help and routing recognizing only registered commands before operation/config/store/handler boundaries
Each parser migration must atomically capture and preserve production argv parity (accept/reject, diagnostics, streams, exit codes) while switching both runtime handler and factory
Generated package-help and grouped-overview artifacts must be byte-deterministic and regenerated from factories, with all aliases reusing canonical artifacts and retired commands remaining unknown
Registry validation must reject duplicate spellings, contradictory policy, unknown capabilities, alias collisions, and missing parser references without requiring full handler imports at startup
Top-level help and routing must serve only generated bytes from registered factories, while existing command execution continues using the compatibility route ladder until RP-04 boundaries
